auto_tankbeurt.name: Car: add refuelling
auto_tankbeurt.description: Adds a refuelling for the car without an integration of its own and updates its odometer. Consumption is worked out from the distance between refuellings.

auto_tankbeurt_verwijderen.name: Car: remove last refuelling
auto_tankbeurt_verwijderen.description: Removes the refuelling with the highest odometer reading.

auto_rdw_ophalen.name: Car: look up at the RDW
auto_rdw_ophalen.description: Looks the licence plate up again in the RDW open data (make, model, APK date, fuel).
